items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: leaving to come back to do this picture that Nazzarro sent a telegram to us while we were finishing up Transatlantic Rhythm

ctx.x: Can you tell me about anything that stands out in your mind about any people that you met? Is there perhaps some experience that you had with them that you can recall?

Burns and Allen are about the only ones I know that I met concerning anything, any rifts concerning the theater about billing and dressing rooms and all that stuff. That's the only two people. We got over that, we got over that one, we got over all of 'em. They were all simple.

So what else did I want to tell you, I wanted to tell you something -- oh, I know what it was -- leaving to come back to do this picture that Nazzarro sent a telegram to us while we were finishing up Transatlantic Rhythm --
